market_summary: Across all 6 symbols during the London session, markets are characterized by tight mean-reverting consolidations clustered inside Value Areas around Point of Control (POC) levels. Gold, Silver, and Bitcoin are consolidating below downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50 baselines with subdued volume and bearish CVD, lacking continuation triggers. EURUSD is completely coiled around flat, intertwined baselines, while GBPUSD shows an unconfirmed VAH test diverging sharply against bearish CVD. US100 is rebounding from Session Lows but testing immediate structural confluence at POC and EMA50. With all assets mid-channel or lacking RVOL breakout confirmation, capital preservation mandates an all-HOLD stance.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and hovering right above POC (3896.98). CVD is BEARISH (-2.24 with slope -0.46), showing continued seller presence, but price is trapped in a tight range. Current session is LONDON_SESSION. RVOL is low at 0.845 with no yellow volume spikes confirming directional momentum. Bounded by S/R support at 3887.45 and Session Low at 3878.91 below, with Session High at 3922.99 above. With price consolidating inside the Value Area at fair value, setup dictates HOLD.

Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is flat against VWAP (1.10596), EMA20 (1.10608), and EMA50 (1.10607), all of which are coiling tightly horizontally. ATR band position is mid-channel between 1.10501 and 1.10715. RVOL is moderate at 1.544 but lacks a >2.0 yellow breakout spike. Price is boxed between immediate S/R resistance at 1.10662 / Session High 1.10726 and S/R support at 1.10574 / Session Low 1.10475. Coiled rangebound behavior inside the Value Area warrants a HOLD.

Price is above VAH (1.32378) and above POC (1.32349). However, CVD is BEARISH (-2,921 with slope -1,291.67), showing severe delta divergence against the push higher. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades above VWAP (1.32328) and above EMA50 (1.32348). ATR band position is stretching toward the upper green band (1.32459). RVOL is weak at 0.916, lacking the mandatory yellow RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation required to validate a true VAH expansion breakout, indicating a high risk of a breakout trap. Price is directly confronting Session High resistance at 1.32431 while holding above S/R support at 1.32391. Delta divergence and unconfirmed volume dictate a HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28159.05 to VAH 28398.09) and currently testing fair-value POC (28264.08) from below. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.35 with slope +0.07). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains below session VWAP (28316.59) and is testing EMA50 (28274.59) resistance. ATR band position is mid-channel between 28134.47 and 28347.25. RVOL is 1.068 (US100 CFD tick volume rarely prints >2.0 yellow spikes, but directional momentum is hitting strong confluence). Price is currently testing immediate S/R resistance at 28265.71 after a sharp rebound from Session Low at 28151.81. Entering long directly into overhead POC, EMA50, and S/R resistance offers poor edge, warranting a HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 49.748 to VAH 50.446) and hovering just above POC (49.928). CVD is BEARISH (-101.4 with slope -8.07), but price has stalled and flattened. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (50.193) and below EMA50 (50.175). ATR band position is mid-channel between 49.689 and 50.393 with contracting volatility. RVOL is 1.36 without yellow volume spike confirmation. Price is resting right on S/R support at 49.922 with Session Low at 49.579 below and S/R resistance at 50.313 / Session High 50.783 above. Sideways compression around POC inside Value Area warrants a disciplined HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 67782.90 to VAH 70190.61) positioned slightly above POC (68676.09). CVD is BEARISH (-0.05 with flat slope 0.0). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (69393.52) and well below EMA50 (69710.02), currently testing EMA20 baseline (68879.67). ATR band position is mid-channel between 68175.95 and 69583.39 with contracting volatility. RVOL is low at 0.846 with no yellow volume expansion. Key structural levels include Session Low support at 67549.90 below and Prev Low / Session High resistance above 71031.00. Sub-volume chop inside the Value Area below primary baselines dictates a HOLD.
